Process

How a project runs, start to finish

01

Discovery call

A short conversation by video call or phone about your business, your customers, and what the site needs to do for you.

02

Fixed quote

A clear, written price and timeline before anything is built — no surprise invoices later.

03

Design & build

You review drafts at key checkpoints, not just once at the end. Typical builds run 4–8 weeks.

04

Launch & handoff

Your site goes live, connected to your domain and Google Business Profile, with a short walkthrough of how to make simple edits.

05

Ongoing care (optional)

A monthly plan covers hosting, updates, and small content changes so the site keeps working long after launch.

About the founder

Thirty years in enterprise tech. Now built for small business.

30Years in technology consulting
CA & USFortune 500 clients, coast to coast
1Point of contact, start to finish

After 30 years in technology consulting, working with Fortune 500 companies across Canada and the United States, I’ve learned what makes technology projects succeed — and what gets in the way.

I’ve seen firsthand how great ideas can become slowed down by layers of approvals, complicated processes, unclear accountability, and escalating costs. I created Deep Cortex Designs to offer small businesses a different experience.

My approach is simple: direct communication, clear scope, transparent pricing, and personal accountability from the first conversation through to launch. When you work with Deep Cortex Designs, you work directly with the person designing and building your website — no layers of account managers, no unnecessary complexity, and no getting lost in the process.

I bring the standards and experience of enterprise technology consulting to small-business web design, while keeping the process practical, personal, and efficient.

The goal isn't simply to build a website. It's to create a professional online presence that helps your business build credibility, connect with customers, and grow.

Based in the Niagara Region, Ontario, Deep Cortex Designs works virtually with businesses across Canada — one conversation, one project, and one successful launch at a time.

FAQ

Common questions

How long does a project take?

Most builds run 4–8 weeks from discovery call to launch, depending on scope. The Starter Website is the exception — as a limited-time promo, Starter builds can be delivered in as little as 48 hours. You'll get a specific timeline with your fixed quote.

What's included in the price?

Everything scoped in your quote up front — design, build, mobile responsiveness, and Google Business Profile setup on Starter and up. No surprise invoices partway through.

Do I own my website afterward?

Yes — the site is yours. A monthly care plan is available for hosting, updates, and small edits, but it's optional, not a lock-in.

Do you work with businesses outside Niagara?

Yes — Deep Cortex Designs is based in the Niagara Region, Ontario, but works with small businesses across Canada. Discovery calls, design reviews, and launch all happen over video and email, so location isn't a barrier.

Do you offer ongoing support after launch?

Optional monthly care plans cover hosting, uptime monitoring, and small content edits — $49–$99/mo.
